scenes.contextualRelevance: The experiment teaches viewers about viscosity and laminar flow using corn syrup and colored drops.

narrativeProgression.description: A drop of red corn syrup is placed in the container.
A drop of green corn syrup is placed in the container.
A drop of blue corn syrup is placed in the container.
The container is slowly rotated clockwise 5 times.
The container is slowly rotated counterclockwise 5 times, returning the colors to their original state.

scenes.thematicElements: The video demonstrates the viscosity of corn syrup by showcasing the movement and mixing of colored drops with laminar flow.
